title: Retinexformer: One-stage Retinex-based Transformer for Low-light Image Enhancement
layout_note: Full-width overview band on top: a short left-to-right estimator on the left feeds a U-shaped restorer whose encoder runs right along the top row, turns down at the right edge and returns left along the bottom row, ending at the output image in the middle of the band. Two detail panels sit side by side below it.
grouping: Three tinted background panels with square corners and thin borders: (a) a pale-green full-width top band, and below it (b) pale cream-yellow on the left and (c) pale peach on the right, each titled '(letter) Name' top-left in bold coloured sans-serif. Inside (a) the two sub-stages have no boxes; they are separated by position only and named by bold navy captions '(i) ...' and '(ii) ...' along the band's bottom edge. One shared legend box sits top-centre of (a); (b) has its own legend box along its bottom. Colour families mark op types consistently: yellow for the attention block, FFN and feature maps, light blue for LN and depth-wise conv, green for stride-2 conv, orange for deconv, pinkish-brown for conv 3x3, tan for conv 1x1; in (c) the Q/K/V token stacks are orange/green/cyan with matching coloured bold letters.
shapes_depth: Flat oblique 3-D extrusions, no shadows, square corners: named blocks (IGAB, LN, IG-MSA, FFN) are cuboids with a lighter front face, darker top/side faces and an outline darker than the fill. Single conv layers are thin parallelogram slabs whose height shrinks at each downsampled level, so resolution reads from slab size. Feature maps are two or three overlapping offset slabs; the light-up feature is a stack of image slabs; reshaped tokens are staggered stacks of small square tiles; the CxC attention map is a flat heatmap parallelogram. Image inputs and outputs are borderless square photo thumbnails. Operators are small black-outlined circles with glyphs. Arrows are thin black lines with filled heads, routed with diagonal jogs instead of right-angle elbows; tensor shapes are small light-grey labels beside each tensor, and bold math symbols label the arrows.
proposed_highlight: The method name titles panel (a) and its two new modules title panels (b) and (c), each in a bold colour tied to its panel. The attention block is the only labelled cuboid in the U-shaped restorer, drawn in warm yellow with a small xN repeat subscript and given its own legend entry; panel (b) expands it, singling out IG-MSA by a salmon fill between blue LN and yellow FFN, and panel (c) expands IG-MSA. The light-up feature line leaves the overview and crosses the panel border into both (b) and (c), making the guidance path visible. Blue and red zoom callouts (small squares on two thumbnails tied by thin coloured lines to rounded insets of patch pairs, keyed by coloured italic text) point at artefacts in the intermediate image.
lesson: Each detail panel's background tint repeats the fill of the block it expands (cream-yellow panel for the yellow IGAB cuboid, peach panel for the salmon IG-MSA block), and one guidance line runs from the overview across the panel border into both detail panels, so the reader can follow both the zoom-in and the conditioning signal.
notes: Two levels of nested expansion (overview -> block -> attention) are packed into one figure by giving the overview the full width and splitting the lower band between the two detail panels.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: a full-width band (a) holds two titled stages side by side: (i) Illumination Estimator on the left turning the input image and illumination prior into a lit-up image and light-up feature, (ii) the U-shaped Corruption Restorer on the right producing the enhanced image

relations.form: band (a) split into (i) Illumination Estimator (left, real photos and colour-mapped maps) and (ii) Corruption Restorer (right, a U of yellow IGAB cuboids), each captioned in bold below
inside (ii) the U runs right along the top (conv, IGAB, stride-conv slabs), down the right side, and back left along the bottom to I_re, then + I_lu into the Enhanced Image
the light-up feature F_lu, drawn as a real colour-mapped image, leaves (i) on a long line down into IG-MSA in panel (b) and on to the Y branch of panel (c), where it multiplies the value tokens
panel (b) (cream) expands one IGAB into LN -> IG-MSA -> + -> LN -> FFN -> +; panel (c) (peach) expands IG-MSA into tokenised Q/K/V stacks, a C x C attention map and positional encoding
in panel (c) features are reshaped into rows of small token squares (orange Q, green K, blue V) and the attention is a small dark C x C matrix
blue and red squares on the lit-up and enhanced images lead to boxed crop insets labelled i (over-exposure) and ii (amplified noise, colour distortion)

channels.colour: layer colour = operation type, keyed in a top legend (yellow IGAB, beige conv 1x1, blue depth-wise conv, brown conv 3x3, green stride conv, orange deconv); token colour = Q/K/V role; blue/red insets = the two corruption types; panel tint = which part is expanded - colour carries at least three meanings
channels.shape: oblique 3-D cuboids and parallelogram slabs = layers, real images and colour maps = data, circled glyphs = element-wise ops
channels.line: solid black arrows only; blue and red thin lines tie image regions to their crop insets
channels.frame: tinted square-cornered panels = (a) whole model, (b) and (c) detail; rounded boxes = legends and corruption insets

quality.strengths: intermediate data is drawn as real images (light-up map, lit-up image, colour-mapped light-up feature), so the illumination guidance is visible as data; the guided attention is drawn as token stacks and an attention matrix rather than a block; each operation type is keyed
quality.weaknesses: the F_lu guidance line runs diagonally across the band border and then the full width of panel (b) into (c), the longest wire in the figure; colour carries op type, Q/K/V role, corruption type and panel identity at once; the corruption insets sit in the middle of the band between the two stages; the detail panels are tied to their parent block only by titles and approximate tint

insights.structure: A pale-green full-width band (a) holds the illumination estimator (i) on the left and the U-shaped corruption restorer (ii) on the right; below, a cream panel (b) details the attention block and a peach panel (c) details the illumination-guided self-attention, each titled in bold coloured text top-left.
insights.data: Real photos for input, light-up map, lit-up and enhanced images; feature maps as stacks of coloured slabs; layers as oblique 3-D cuboids and thin parallelogram slabs coloured by op type (yellow IGAB, blue LN, green stride conv, orange deconv), with tensor sizes in grey beside each.
insights.emphasis: The light-up feature F_lu is drawn as a real colour-mapped image and routed by long lines from (a) into the IG-MSA blocks of (b) and (c), plus coloured callouts (i over-exposure, ii amplified noise) showing the problem being fixed.
insights.flow: Estimator left to right; restorer encoder runs right along the top row, turns down at the right edge and returns left along the bottom to the enhanced image; panel (c) runs left to right through Q/K/V token stacks to the output feature.
insights.avoid: Very dense: two legend boxes, many grey size labels and long cross-panel lines make it crowded at column width.

arrangement.units: three tinted square-cornered background panels: one full-width top band, two half-width detail panels below
arrangement.inputs_as: real low-light photo plus illumination prior map
arrangement.shared: op-type colour coding and a shared legend across panels
